value_function: merge_readiness = verified_outcome * reproducibility * safety * maintainability / complexity

readiness.rollback: revert the PR or remove rust-accel-gate from required checks in branch protection only through documented break-glass review

status_semantics.REST: all required validation categories have executable evidence and no contract drift
status_semantics.ACTION: one or more validation categories are missing, malformed, or drifted

acceptance_criteria.pass_condition: all unit, property, fuzz-smoke, and PyO3-enabled tests pass
Criterion smoke benchmark exits successfully and emits timing evidence

categories.purpose: Verify convolution modes across generated finite signal/kernel pairs against an independent reference implementation.
invariants: full mode equals independent full-convolution reference
same mode equals centered slice of full reference
valid mode equals valid slice of full reference
fixed seed makes generated cases reproducible
categories.failure_action: Block merge and inspect the smallest generated case printed by the Rust assertion failure.

categories.purpose: Exercise numeric kernels with bounded byte-derived deterministic fuzz-smoke inputs to detect panics and invalid indexing under cargo test.
invariants: fuzz-smoke execution is part of the locked cargo test command
cargo-fuzz deep harness remains available outside the release gate
input lengths are bounded before slices are formed
non-finite floats are normalized before kernel calls
categories.failure_action: Preserve the failing byte-derived input, add it as a regression unit test, then patch.

categories.purpose: Parse top-level workflow keys and job ids into a repository-owned AST before validating required merge-gate contracts.
invariants: duplicate top-level YAML keys are fatal
required jobs, triggers, dependency-review severity, and Rust gate commands are enforced
categories.failure_action: Treat ACTION output as policy drift and repair workflow/docs before merge.

categories.purpose: Run a bounded Criterion smoke benchmark in rust-accel-gate to surface CPU-regression evidence for numeric kernels.
invariants: benchmark command is enforced by the PR-gate contract validator
sample size and measurement time are bounded for synchronous CI
Criterion output is emitted in the CI log
categories.failure_action: Block merge, compare Criterion output against the last green run, and reduce or justify the regression.

automation.evidence: JSON stdout with UTC timestamps, selected acceptance criteria, command strings, exit codes, durations, stdout/stderr hashes, raw stdout/stderr, and tool versions
automation.failure_policy: nonzero exit when any selected acceptance criterion exits nonzero or when the manifest is malformed; manifest readiness is contract_specified until runner status is PASS
